name: OperationsClock
description: Simplified time control for quick operations time range selection with configurable intervals

rows.name: Time Range Settings
rows.description: Configure past and future time ranges with interval counts and units.

components.name: Past Interval Count
components.description: Number of past interval buttons (0-10). Shows multiple buttons (e.g., 2 shows: -2, -1 week, Today). Set to 0 to disable past buttons.

components.name: Future Interval Count
components.description: Number of future interval buttons (0-10). Shows multiple buttons (e.g., 2 shows: Today, +1 week, +2). Set to 0 to disable future buttons.

components.name: Past Unit
components.description: Time unit for past range. Used for -1 button label in interval mode.

components.name: Future Unit
components.description: Time unit for future range. Used for +1 button label in interval mode.

components.name: Tooltip Refresh Interval (seconds)
components.description: How often the tooltip dates update (in seconds). Default is 3600 (1 hour).

rows.name: TimeControl Integration
rows.description: Configure integration with the Time Tab's Initial Start Time

components.name: Use Initial Start Time as Today
components.description: When enabled and the Time Tab has an Initial Start Time configured, use that date as 'Today' instead of the current date. The 'Back to Today' button will also return to the Initial Start Time instead of the current date.
